Hi Zach,

You're not blacklisted, and nothing about this is your fault. I checked your account this morning and the honest answer is worse than that: there is no return open on Shop···· at all, no label was ever bought, and no email about it has ever gone out to you. The forms you filed never turned into anything. Two weeks of chasing us for that is not acceptable, and I'm sorry.

Here is where it stands. Your NerdQX 8TH/s was delivered August 10, the fault is a VREG overheat with voltage protection on a stock unit that trips within seconds from cold, and you confirmed it was never overclocked or modified. That is a straightforward warranty failure, so this is a return and a free replacement, not a repair argument.

I tried to buy the prepaid return label myself just now and the label system rejected the quote, twice. Rather than send you round again, I've put the whole case in front of the team with the fault details, the history and what went wrong on our side. Your return reference is Shop····. They pick this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the label plus the replacement arrangement will come to (email hidden) Please don't file another form, it's logged now.

Please do check your junk folder too, our mail has been landing there for some customers lately.

Sorry again for the run around, Zach.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thanks Sarah. I'll keep an eye out for the email. Hopefully i can get
this resolved.

Hi Zach,

What you were told on the phone is not right, and I am sorry you were left with that impression. We are not waiting on a manufacturer and this is not a months-long thing. Your NerdQX came from our own stock, the replacement comes from our own warehouse, and the faulty unit comes back to our returns dock in Chattanooga, Tennessee. No one overseas is involved in getting you a working miner.

I also found the real reason you never got a label. The system we buy return labels through has been rejecting every request because of a fault on our side, not yours, which is why your forms went nowhere and nobody could tell you why. That is fixed. Your return is now costed and ready to go, UPS Ground Saver, reference Shop····, shipping prepaid by us.

The one thing left is the sign-off on the warranty claim, and that is sitting at the top of the team's list for 10am Eastern this morning. The moment it clears I buy the label and send it straight to you in this thread, along with the free replacement NerdQX held in your name. You do not need to do anything else, no more forms and no more phone calls.

For the time you have lost chasing us, I have made you a code for a future order, HD-••••••, which is $25 off anything over $100 and is yours alone.

I will write to you again today either way, Zach.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Really beginning to think this is a scam

Hi Zach,

I understand why it looks that way, and I am not going to tell you your frustration is unreasonable. Three weeks of forms and phone calls with nothing to show for it would make anyone think it.

Here is something concrete. Our technical lead has looked at your unit's fault himself and confirmed it is a genuine hardware failure on a stock miner, so the warranty covers it and there is nothing left to debate about whether it qualifies. The claim is with JD and Georges for the final sign-off right now, and they are at their desks from 10am Eastern this morning. That is the last step.

As soon as it clears I send you the prepaid return label in this thread, with the reference Shop···· to write on the box. Nothing is being referred to anyone overseas and nothing is waiting on a manufacturer.

If it helps to see that there are real people behind this, our Discord is open at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf and JD is in there daily as @nullhashrate, along with a lot of other owners.

You will hear from me today, Zach, and I am not letting this drift again.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
